title: Artificial Intelligence-Based Correlation and Prioritization of Security Incidents: A Critical Review

contributions.purpose: 梳理告警关联技术从静态规则到 AI 范式的演化
contributions.mechanism: PRISMA 系统综述:五大数据库检索 2010-2025 文献,按规则/ML/DL/RL/混合流水线分类
contributions.evaluation: 检索 100 篇→去重 85→筛选 50→最终纳入 31 篇,汇成对比总表(Table III)
contributions.domain: 网络安全 / SOC 告警管理
contributions.source_quote: We analyze and categorize the evolution of techniques from static rule-based systems to dynamic AI-driven paradigms, highlighting the key conceptual shifts.

contributions.purpose: 批判评估各 AI 范式的运行维度优劣
contributions.mechanism: 沿性能/可扩展/可解释三维度定性对比监督、无监督、DL、RL 方法
contributions.evaluation: 核心发现为性能-可解释性两难;引例如 DeepLog F1 96%、TRACE2VEC AUC 0.97、AACT 减 61% 分析师负担(均为二手数据)
contributions.source_quote: The most performant models, particularly in deep learning, often lack the interpretability essential for operational adoption.

contributions.purpose: 识别阻碍实际部署的研究缺口
contributions.mechanism: 从入选文献归纳三类缺口:标注数据稀缺与隐私、对抗环境下鲁棒性评估盲区、运维集成与人因
contributions.evaluation: 定性论断;指出绝大多数研究只在静态良性数据集上评估,未测对抗攻击与概念漂移
contributions.source_quote: We identify the persistent research gaps and challenges that hinder the practical deployment of these models, including data scarcity, model robustness, and the human factor.

contributions.mechanism: 三优先方向:检测模型+LLM 生成自然语言解释的 XAI、联邦/迁移学习解决数据稀缺、RLHF 式 human-in-the-loop 协作
contributions.source_quote: We outline promising future research directions toward the development of truly explainable (XAI) and collaborative human-in-the-loop systems, aiming to foster synergy between AI and human expertise.

self_declared_provenance.quote: To ensure a comprehensive, transparent, and reproducible analysis, this study adopts the PRISMA (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses) framework [8].
